title: Study on annealing treatment of NbMoTaTiNi high-entropy alloy with ultra-high strength disordered-ordered transition structure for additive manufacturing
process_description: prepared by selective laser melting (SLM) with a power of 300 W, layer thickness of 50 µm, and scanning speed of 300 mm/s, followed by annealing at various temperatures (600-1300 °C) for 4 hours.
